card.name: Numbers before time units
card.fires_on: A number (or its first digit) that counts a duration, right before words like weeks, months, days, minutes or birthday. It fits spans and intervals such as 'every 8 weeks' or 'until 6 months'.

modes.description: A number marking how long something lasts or up to what age, before months, days or minutes.

modes.label: Digit starting a longer number
modes.description: The first digit of a two-digit time count, with the next digit still to come.
